question: Does the live in-zone promotion bonus (weight*unit) ever pay a piece that can actually promote in that position, and do the stored games ever choose a promotion from an in-zone or half-bonus-intent square?
why_it_changes_a_decision: Stage 7 showed the in-zone branch fires on 2489 of 8083 promotable observations (30.8%). That is a reachability count and says nothing about whether the paid piece could promote. If the full bonus pays only pieces with no legal promotion available, then the term is not a promotion-potential reward at all and its 30.8% share must not be read as promotion-relevant activity; that would change what, if anything, a follow-up should try to repair.
no_new_search: Replay of stored move lists only. No search, no game generation, no fitness evaluation, no evaluator change.

design.same_corpus_and_dedup: identical file list and (seed, depth, game_index, moves) dedup as results_stored_games_leaf_terms.json, so the counts are comparable with Stage 7
design.replay_precondition: same as Stage 7: replayed terminal status, winner and ply count must equal the stored values or the game is recorded as a problem and excluded
design.legal_actions_per_position: legal_actions(state, compiled) once per scanned position; promotion actions are those with promotion_target_id not None, grouped by from_square
design.in_zone_payment_contact: for each position where at least one unpromoted promotable piece lies in its evaluator zone, test whether that same square has a legal promotion action in that position
design.chosen_move_class: each stored move is classified drop / q promoted (promotion_target_id not None) / q quiet; for promotions the square the piece stood on before the move is looked up in the zone and dead-intent sets
design.position_class: in-zone observations are split into the replay's start position (index 0) and positions reached after a stored move (index >= 1)

endpoint_written_before_the_run.primary_decision: in_zone_full_bonus_has_no_immediate_promotion_contact if zero in-zone paid pieces have a legal promotion in the same position; otherwise in_zone_full_bonus_has_immediate_promotion_contact with the exact share
endpoint_written_before_the_run.secondary_decision: promotions_chosen_from_in_zone = <x> of <y> chosen promotions; report separately from the share of in-zone observations
counts_to_report: positions scanned, legal_actions cost (wall seconds), problems
in-zone paid piece observations, and how many of them have a legal promotion available
chosen moves by class, promotions by from-square class (in-zone / dead-intent / neither)
in-zone observations at the start position versus reached during play
endpoint_written_before_the_run.what_this_cannot_establish: not utility, not search-behaviour effect, not strength; zero contact on these short 2-3 ply board-4 games does not prove zero contact in deeper play at boards 6 and 8, and a legal promotion being available does not mean search would choose it

amendment_1_written_2026-10-18T14:07Z_be.trigger: The first run returned in_zone_with_legal_promotion=53 of 2489 in-zone payments, which is an absolute count without a base rate. A rate of 2.1% is only interpretable against the same rate for promotable pieces that are not in the zone.
amendment_1_written_2026-10-18T14:07Z_be.added_measurement: For every promotable-piece observation record whether that square has at least one legal promotion in that position, split into in-zone / dead-intent / neither, so the in-zone rate can be compared with the other classes on the same positions.
amendment_1_written_2026-10-18T14:07Z_be.added_decision: in_zone_promotability_is_depressed_relative_to_other_promotable_pieces if the in-zone rate is at least two times smaller than the pooled not-in-zone rate; otherwise in_zone_promotability_matches_other_promotable_pieces. The ratio and both raw fractions are to be reported either way.
amendment_1_written_2026-10-18T14:07Z_be.not_changed: No input, no replay precondition, no dedup, no evaluator edit, no search.

done_condition: one written verdict with the two decisions above, all counts, the wall-clock cost, and the scope limits, saved beside this plan and reported in the segment checkpoint
